title: The Nephite Priesthood
summary: Latter-day sorcerers who claim secret arts handed down from the prophet Nephi.

claims.text: The Priesthood traces itself to Nephi, who in its telling led Lehi's family from Jerusalem to the New World in the seventh century BC.
It holds that Nephi received hidden gifts in visions, such as command of the elements, speech with the dead, dream-lore, healing and the summoning of spirits, and passed them to a chosen few.
These secrets were kept apart from the public church that Joseph Smith founded and Brigham Young led to the Salt Lake basin.

title: Thal'hun
summary: Sorcerers who say their power is the science of an alien race.

claims.text: The Thal'hun teach that there is no magic, only advanced science from ancient civilisations among the stars.

Their lore tells of the Hui:xa of the world Barshm, whose own virus destroyed their biosphere; their priest-scientists moved part of the city Zoraster outside time and space, and the survivors became envoys to seek a worthy race.

title: The Uzoma
summary: Yoruba babalawos called to sorcery by the orishas.

claims.text: The Uzoma say they have been one with the Yoruba from the beginning, called by the orishas to serve as priests and sorcerers to the chiefs of holy Ife.
In the Americas the orisha faith joined with Christian saints to form Candomble, Vodoun, Macumba and others; at home, under Portuguese and British rule, the Uzoma went into hiding.
As colonial rule ended, the Uzoma began to come out of hiding and bring the people back to the orishas.

title: The Fenian
summary: An Irish clan of half-fae shapeshifters.

claims.text: The Fenian claim an unbroken line from the Tuatha De Danann; in old times they changed into beasts, had faerie sight, and became bards, warriors or seal-folk.
They have allies among the Fianna tribe, Old World kith and their ancestral ghosts, and once guarded mortals from Wyrmspawn; fomori can sense the changing blood and are driven to kill them.

title: The Seven Thunders
summary: Secret holy commandos who strike at sorcerers with True Faith.

claims.text: Unlike the Society of Leopold, the Seven Thunders work in secret, through manipulation and sudden terror, armed with True Faith.
